description: Convert a date and time between IANA time zones with exact daylight-saving handling, inspect a zone's offset and transitions, or list a country's zones. Cost: 1 credit per call. Output: JSON. convert: {input, output, offset_from, offset_to, dst_from, dst_to, utc, ...}; info: {tz, offset, abbreviation, dst, previous_transition, next_transition}; list: {country, zones, count}

country.description: list: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US. Omit to list every zone.

datetime.description: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-03-29T01:30:00 (wall clock in from_tz / tz) or 2026-03-29T00:30:00Z / 2026-03-29T01:30:00+01:00 (exact instant). Required for convert and info.

from_tz.description: convert: source zone, an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin or a fixed offset such as +05:30. Required when datetime has no offset.

query.description: list: only zones whose name contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. york or europe/

to_tz.description: convert: target zone, an IANA name or a fixed offset. Required for convert.

tz.description: info: the zone to describe, an IANA name or a fixed offset (from_tz is accepted as an alias). Required for info.

name: timezone_convert
title: Time zone converter
